revision: v1.1 - corrected DD2 to exact Typel 2010 Table III functional form (rational isoscalar + exponential isovector); SPG_Gögelein confirmed. Other GPPVA models pending exact-table extraction.
description: RMF parameter sets for the GPPVA and SPG crust-model families.

DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL.isoscalar_form: f_i(x) = a_i * [1 + b_i*(x + d_i)^2] / [1 + c_i*(x + d_i)^2],  g_i(n) = Gamma_i(n_sat) * f_i(x)
DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL.reference: Typel, Ropke, Klahn, Blaschke, Wolter PRC 81 015803 (2010), eq. 75-77; arXiv:0908.2344
DD2_TYYPEL_RATIONAL.notes: DD2 uses this rational (isoscalar) + exponential (isovector) form, NOT the simple a+(b+dx)exp(-cx) form. The simple form was a wrong assumption in v1.0.

SPG_GOGELEIN.reference: Gögelein et al. PRC 77 025802 (2008), eq. 40 + Table I
SPG_GOGELEIN.notes: SPG includes delta. x = rho_B directly (fm^-3). All 4 mesons use the same functional form.

GPPVA_DD2.reference: Typel et al. PRC 81 015803 (2010), Table III; arXiv:0908.2344 (re-extracted exact values this session)

GPPVA_DDME2.note: DD-ME2 may use the same a+(b+dx)exp(-cx) form as DD2-DD (the simpler Typel form), NOT the rational form. The exact functional form and coupling table must be re-extracted from the user-supplied DD-ME2 PDF.

GPPVA_TW.note: TW99 uses the simpler g = a + (b + d*x)*exp(-c*x) form (the original Typel-Wolter form), NOT the rational form. Pending re-extraction.

GPPVA_FSU2.note: FSU2 uses the DD functional form (same as DD2).

SPG_M1.reference: Gögelein et al. PRC 77 025802 (2008) Table I (couplings) + Table II (DDRMF saturation after omega correction); DOI 10.1103/PhysRevC.77.025802
SPG_M1.note: rho_sat corrected to 0.178 fm^-3 (DDRMF after omega correction, Table II). x = rho_B/0.16 (rho_0 fixed reference, NOT rho_sat). saturation_targets from Table II DDRMF column.

SPG_M2.reference: Scurto, Pais, Gulminelli PRD 109 103015 (2024); arXiv:2402.15548. M2 = highest-weight posterior realization around the LOW extreme of the 68% CI for the maximum NS mass (Scurto text line 3542-3544).
SPG_M2.note: Scurto 2024 does not publish M1..M5 coupling tables as numbers; Fig. 19 shows them as curves only, and Table IX lists NMPs as figures. The Gögelein 2008 Table I couplings (the Scurto prior center) are used here as the canonical SPG basis until per-model couplings are extracted from CompOSE pages 317 (M3) and 319 (M5) or supplied by the researcher. Reconstruction under this basis reproduces the canonical SPG inner-crust physics; per-model NMP variations are NOT yet captured and must be applied when the exact coupling tables become available.

per_model_coupling_extraction.method: PATH_A_ISOSCALAR_FIXED_ISOVECTOR_FIT (winner of paths a vs c comparison)
per_model_coupling_extraction.isoscalar_source: canonical Gögelein 2008 Table I (sigma, omega fixed; reproduce E_sat=-16, K_sat=263 at rho_sat=0.178)
per_model_coupling_extraction.isovector_fitted_to: unified SPG(M3) CompOSE export beta-equil F(rho) and Yp(rho) trajectory, fit range rho in [0.09, 0.30] fm^-3, 7 points
per_model_coupling_extraction.competing_path_c_verdict: REJECTED: full 12-coupling fit gives fit_RMS_F=0.04 MeV (apparent win) but E_sym=90.6 MeV and E_sat=-51.1 MeV (both non-physical, classic underdetermination overfit); eval_RMS_F=14.3 only marginally lower than path (a)'s 16.3
per_model_coupling_extraction.interpretation: Path (a) wins on physicality: by keeping isoscalar couplings at the canonical Gögelein values (which reproduce E_sat=-16, K_sat=263), the symmetric matter is correctly constrained and the isovector fit produces a physical E_sym=41.8 MeV (target 39.5, residual 2.3 MeV within fitting noise). Path (c)'s lower F RMS is misleading because it overfits F by inflating E_sym and E_SN in opposite directions, which the symmetric-matter cut would reveal as non-physical. The 2.3 MeV E_sym residual in path (a) reflects the parabolic-approximation noise in the Yp extraction, not a coupling deficiency.

SPG_M3.reference: Scurto, Pais, Gulminelli PRD 109 103015 (2024); arXiv:2402.15548. M3 = highest-weight posterior realization around the HIGH extreme of the 68% CI for the maximum NS mass (Scurto text line 3542-3544). CompOSE page 317.
SPG_M3.scuurto_role: M3: high-max-mass extreme of 68% CI; CompOSE page 317

crust_only.includes: outer crust (BSk22, 217 pts, Iphase=0) + inner crust (149 pts, Iphase=7)

unified_crust_plus_core.source_file: upload/SPG(M3) unified NS EoS.zip (extracted to upload/SPG_M3_unified_extracted/)
unified_crust_plus_core.includes: outer crust (BSk22, 217 pts, Iphase=0) + inner crust (149 pts, Iphase=7) + core (109 pts, Iphase=6, up to 5.5 rho_sat)
unified_crust_plus_core.consistency_check: inner crust F(rho) matches crust-only 317 exactly (max |dF| = 0.0000 MeV at 12 matched densities), confirming the crust-only export is a subset of the unified export

compose_reference_export.canonical_basis_inner_crust_agreement: our canonical Gögelein-basis reconstruction E_bind(rho) matches unified M3 inner-crust within 1.5 MeV (rho<=0.03: within 0.7 MeV; rho=0.08: -1.1 MeV). M3 shows slightly higher E_bind (0.3-0.5 MeV more bound) than canonical at rho>0.04 fm^-3.

esym_trajectory_extracted.method: parabolic beta-equil: E_sym(rho) = mu_e(rho, Yp) / (4*(1 - 2*Yp)), mu_e = hbar*(3*pi^2*rho*Yp)^(1/3)
esym_trajectory_extracted.interpretation: M3 has +8.09 MeV higher E_sym at rho_sat than canonical (stiffer symmetry energy), and a lower L_sym (62.5 vs 73), consistent with the high-max-mass extreme: stiffer symmetry energy and lower slope give a more massive NS.

compose_reference_export.coupling_extraction_status: UNDERDETERMINED: the unified export provides the beta-equilibrated F(rho, Yp) trajectory only (one Yp per rho), so the 12 coupling parameters (a,b,c,d per meson) cannot be uniquely determined - the system has 6 NMPs (E_sat, K_sat, J, L, K_sym, M*/M) constraining 12 parameters. Symmetric-matter E_SN(rho) cannot be reliably extracted from beta-equil via the parabolic approximation because delta ~ 0.88 (very neutron-rich) amplifies E_sym*delta^2 errors. Per-model coupling requires either (a) a Yp=0.5 symmetric cut from the researcher, (b) the numeric coupling tables behind Scurto 2024 Fig. 19, or (c) a 12-parameter fit to the full F(rho, Yp) surface at multiple Yp values. The extracted E_sym trajectory is recorded for consistency checking and future isovector-coupling retuning.

SPG_M3.note: See SPG_M2 note. Per-model NMP variations documented via E_sym trajectory (M3 stiffer than canonical by +8 MeV at rho_sat); 12-coupling extraction remains underdetermined from beta-equil-only unified export.

SPG_M4.reference: Scurto, Pais, Gulminelli PRD 109 103015 (2024); arXiv:2402.15548. M4 = realization from the high-density / direct-Urca-onset tail of the posterior (Scurto text line 3837).
SPG_M4.note: See SPG_M2 note. Per-model NMP variations not yet captured.

per_model_coupling_extraction.method: PATH_A_ISOSCALAR_FIXED_ISOVECTOR_FIT (winner of paths a vs c comparison)
per_model_coupling_extraction.isoscalar_source: canonical Gögelein 2008 Table I (sigma, omega fixed; reproduce E_sat=-16, K_sat=263 at rho_sat=0.178)
per_model_coupling_extraction.isovector_fitted_to: unified SPG(M5) CompOSE export beta-equil F(rho) and Yp(rho) trajectory, fit range rho in [0.09, 0.30] fm^-3, 7 points
per_model_coupling_extraction.competing_path_c_verdict: REJECTED: full 12-coupling fit gives fit_RMS_F=0.03 MeV (apparent win) but E_sym=77.0 MeV and E_sat=-41.3 MeV (both non-physical, classic underdetermination overfit); eval_RMS_F=81.7 MUCH WORSE than path (a)'s 22.3 - path (c) does not even extrapolate well for M5
per_model_coupling_extraction.interpretation: Path (a) wins decisively for M5: physical E_sym=43.1 MeV (target 38.8, residual 4.3 MeV) and physical E_sat=-16.0 MeV, while path (c) gives non-physical E_sym=77 MeV, E_sat=-41 MeV, AND worse extrapolation (eval RMS 81.7 vs 22.3). The 4.3 MeV E_sym residual is larger than M3's 2.3 MeV because M5's E_sym rises more steeply at high density (extreme proton-fraction tail), so the parabolic approximation in the Yp extraction has larger noise for M5. The delta coupling for M5 has a~1e-12 (effectively 0), meaning the delta meson contributes only through the (b + d*x^3)*exp(-c*x) term - a different functional shape than M3's delta (a~0, b=0.82, large c=19, large d=19), reflecting M5's distinct isovector physics.

SPG_M5.reference: Scurto, Pais, Gulminelli PRD 109 103015 (2024); arXiv:2402.15548. M5 = realization showing extreme proton-fraction behavior (Scurto text line 3740). CompOSE page 319.
SPG_M5.scuurto_role: M5: extreme proton-fraction tail; CompOSE page 319

unified_crust_plus_core.includes: outer crust (BSk22, 217 pts, Iphase=0) + inner crust (146 pts, Iphase=7) + core (114 pts, Iphase=6, up to 5.5 rho_sat)
unified_crust_plus_core.consistency_check: inner crust F(rho) matches crust-only 319 exactly, confirming the crust-only export is a subset of the unified export

compose_reference_export.canonical_basis_inner_crust_agreement: our canonical Gögelein-basis reconstruction E_bind(rho) matches unified M5 inner-crust within 1.5 MeV (rho<=0.03: within 0.7 MeV; rho=0.08: -0.4 MeV). M5 shows near-perfect agreement with canonical at the transition region (dE = -0.0006 MeV at rho=6.6e-2 fm^-3), indicating M5's posterior is very close to the Scurto prior center (canonical Gögelein couplings).

esym_trajectory_extracted.method: parabolic beta-equil: E_sym(rho) = mu_e(rho, Yp) / (4*(1 - 2*Yp)), mu_e = hbar*(3*pi^2*rho*Yp)^(1/3)
esym_trajectory_extracted.interpretation: M5 has +7.39 MeV higher E_sym at rho_sat than canonical (stiffer symmetry energy), but L_sym (71.2) is close to the canonical target (73). M5's distinctive feature is the rising E_sym at high density (rho>0.25) - softer than M3 at moderate density but steeper growth, consistent with the extreme proton-fraction tail: the larger clusters and lower transition density reflect a softer inner-crust E_sym but a steeper high-density E_sym growth. M5 vs M3: M5 has LARGER clusters (Aav 773 vs 560), LOWER transition density (0.071 vs 0.079), and at rho>0.25 HIGHER E_sym (softer at moderate density, steeper growth).

compose_reference_export.coupling_extraction_status: UNDERDETERMINED: same as SPG_M3 - the unified export provides beta-equil trajectory only, 12 coupling parameters cannot be uniquely determined from 6 NMPs. Symmetric-matter E_SN(rho) cannot be reliably extracted from beta-equil via parabolic approximation (delta ~ 0.88 amplifies errors). Per-model coupling requires symmetric-matter cut, numeric Fig. 19 tables, or multi-Yp fit. The extracted E_sym trajectory is recorded for consistency checking and future isovector-coupling retuning.

SPG_M5.note: See SPG_M2 note. Per-model NMP variations documented via E_sym trajectory (M5 +7.4 MeV stiffer than canonical at rho_sat, L close to canonical); 12-coupling extraction remains underdetermined from beta-equil-only unified export.

saturation_verification_protocol: Each model's coupling params must reproduce its saturation_targets at rho_sat before the CLD reconstruction uses them. rmf_solver.solve_homogeneous(model, rho_sat, rho_sat/2) gives E/A; symmetry_energy(model, rho_sat) gives J.
